transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Uh... well, I guess I'm here because since I stopped working, I just... can't seem to slow down. I'm always up, moving from one little job to the next all day. Just acts like I still have a crew waiting on me or something. That's about it.
Have you been needing less sleep lately, or finding that you can go with much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
No... not really. I still get tired at night. Sleep about normal, I guess.
Have you been feeling more energetic or unusually confident lately, like you don’t have to worry about things the way you used to?
No... not really. I'm just regular, I guess. I still worry about the same things as always. Nothin's changed there.
Have you noticed your mood being unusually high, overly cheerful, or irritable lately?
No, I wouldn't say so. Mood's just... about the same as it's always been. Not too high, not too low. Just regular.
